item.title: Vietnam Accelerates 6G Research and Commercialization Efforts
item.summary: Vietnam is accelerating its preparations for 6G services, aiming to reduce the timeline for researching, mastering, and commercializing this next generation of telecommunications technology by leveraging its experience from 4G and 5G developments. Latest Read: Telkom Completes USD 4.8 Billion InfraNexia Network Asset Spinoff Nguyễn Anh Cương, Deputy Director of the Vietnam Telecommunications Authority, noted […] The post Vietnam Accelerates 6G Research and Commercialization Efforts appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
